title: The Part Sale switch is disabled while its grid is in edit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with Separate Part Sale pricing on.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click the Part Sale Matrix tab.
  4. Click Edit.
  5. Click the Separate Part Sale pricing switch.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The switch is on and the Part Sale grid shows with Edit.

Step 4:

  • The Part Sale grid is in edit.

Step 5:

  • The switch is disabled: it stays on and no question opens, while the grid stays in edit.
